title: Rescue underway in New Orleans after tanker hits river cruise boat
summary: A tanker struck a cruise boat with 129 passengers on board in New Orleans on Friday, partially submerging the boat.

image.caption: Emergency personnel and crews respond after a tanker crashed into a river cruise boat in New Orleans on Friday. (Enan Chediak/The Advocate/The Associated Press)

blocks.text: A tanker struck a cruise boat with 129 passengers on board in New Orleans on Friday, partially submerging the boat.
People in life-jackets seen in Mississippi River as emergency crews respond
Rescues were underway on the Mississippi River, officials said. Authorities did not immediately release whether there were injuries or deaths.
Video from the scene showed the much larger Atlantic Asphalt tanker hit the paddlewheel river boat while it appeared to be docked.

People were seen in the river in life-jackets or standing near the boat's railing as the other side of the American Heritage paddlewheeler listed further into the water. Other footage showed people being pulled from the water and debris, including deck chairs, floating in the river.
The boat is operated by American Cruise Lines.
Lt. Stephanie C. Norwood with New Orleans Emergency Medical Services said all agencies are responding to rescue efforts.
